concepts.def: A burning splint is held at the open end of a test tube of the gas; hydrogen burns rapidly with a pop sound.
A wooden splint that has been lit so it carries a flame; it is held at the open end of the test tube in the hydrogen test.
The short, sharp squeak heard as hydrogen burns rapidly at the mouth of the test tube; it is the positive result for hydrogen.
A glowing splint is inserted into a test tube of the gas; the splint relights in oxygen.
A splint that has been lit and then blown out, so the tip is still glowing red hot but carries no flame.
The glowing tip of the splint bursts back into flame when it is inserted into oxygen; this is the positive result for oxygen.
An aqueous solution of calcium hydroxide, used as the test reagent for carbon dioxide.
Carbon dioxide is shaken with or bubbled through limewater; the limewater turns milky (cloudy).
The white, opaque appearance limewater takes on when carbon dioxide is passed through it; it is the positive result for carbon dioxide.
Damp litmus paper is put into the chlorine gas; the litmus paper is bleached and turns white.
Litmus paper moistened with water before it is put into the gas; the chlorine test uses damp, not dry, litmus paper.
The colour of the litmus paper is removed so that the paper turns white; this is the positive result for chlorine.

mcqs.q: A burning splint is held at the open end of a test tube of an unknown gas. Which observation shows that the gas is hydrogen?
options: The gas burns rapidly with a pop sound
The splint relights, burning brightly
The splint is put out straight away
The gas burns with a steady flame
mcqs.explain: This is the stated result of the hydrogen test: hydrogen burns rapidly with a pop sound.

mcqs.q: Which procedure and result together make up the test for hydrogen?
options: A glowing splint is inserted and then relights
Damp litmus paper is held in it and whitens
A burning splint at the open end gives a pop
A burning splint at the open end goes out
mcqs.explain: The test uses a burning splint held at the open end of the tube, and hydrogen burns rapidly with a pop sound.

mcqs.q: A glowing splint is inserted into a test tube of gas and the splint relights. Which conclusion is correct?
options: The gas is carbon dioxide, as it relights splints
The gas is oxygen, as it relights the splint
The relighting shows the gas is burning itself
The gas is hydrogen, as it relights splints
mcqs.explain: The splint relights in oxygen, so relighting identifies the gas as oxygen.

mcqs.q: Which splint and which result are used to identify oxygen?
options: A burning splint that then relights
A glowing splint that lights the gas
A burning splint that gives a pop
A glowing splint that relights
mcqs.explain: The oxygen test inserts a glowing splint into the tube and the splint relights.

mcqs.q: Limewater is used in the test for carbon dioxide. What is limewater?
options: An aqueous solution of sodium hydroxide
An aqueous solution of calcium hydroxide
An aqueous calcium carbonate solution
An aqueous calcium chloride solution
mcqs.explain: The specification defines limewater as an aqueous solution of calcium hydroxide.

mcqs.q: Carbon dioxide is bubbled through limewater. What is observed?
options: The limewater turns a bright yellow
The limewater is bleached white
The limewater stays unchanged
The limewater turns milky (cloudy)
mcqs.explain: The stated result is that the limewater turns milky (cloudy).

mcqs.q: Damp litmus paper is put into a test tube of chlorine gas. What happens to the paper?
options: It turns bright red and stays red
It turns green like the gas
It is bleached and turns white
It turns blue, showing an alkali
mcqs.explain: The stated result is that the damp litmus paper is bleached and turns white.

mcqs.q: Which observation identifies a gas as chlorine?
options: Damp litmus paper turns white
Dry litmus paper turns bright white
Damp litmus paper turns deep red
Limewater goes cloudy and milky
mcqs.explain: Chlorine bleaches damp litmus paper, so the paper turns white.
